name: OpenCreativeLibrary
description: Invoke native Creative Mode navigation from the existing main menu; does not choose a sword or load Forge.
errors: nil,error when main menu/native button capability unavailable
builds: Requires native CommonButtonBase click capability and live WBP_MainMenu.
limitations: Game-thread UI call; navigation completes asynchronously. No guarantee that a particular feature panel is ready immediately.

name: GetCompatibilityData
description: Returns a detached copy of selected executable patch metadata, or data scoped to a mod ID.
errors: Invalid mod ID raises an error; unknown executables return an unknown profile and empty mod data.
builds: Exact SHA256 selects Main or Bleeding Edge patch packs. Branch labels alone never select native patches.
limitations: Native helpers must be explicitly verified for the selected executable. Metadata identification does not certify gameplay behavior.

name: BindMod
description: Binds runtime handlers using existing mod.json metadata; metadata-only discovery needs no registration.
errors: Returns nil and a stable reason when the required game service is unavailable; invalid IDs raise validation errors.
builds: Backend is selected centrally; no branch-specific code belongs in the consuming mod.
limitations: Legacy raw-object APIs are preserved; transient Unreal objects require validity checks. The new services have simulated regression coverage, not blanket live gameplay certification.
